mapper.select: select ${dataField} as `fieldData`,${timeField} as `timeData` from `environmental_monitoring` where ${dataField} = (select MAX(${dataField}) from `environmental_monitoring` where `data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime})

select ${dataField} as `fieldData`,${timeField} as `timeData` from `environmental_monitoring` where ${dataField} = (select MIN(${dataField}) from `environmental_monitoring` where `data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime})

SELECT DISTINCT a.`record_id`, a.${dataField} `dataValue`, a.`data_time` `dataTime`, b.`code` `deviceId`, b.`area_name` `areaName` FROM `environmental_monitoring` a LEFT JOIN `security_device` b ON a.`device_id` = b.`third_party_id`
a.`data_time` between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
